title: Commentary on the Song of Songs, Prologus
blurb: Origen’s Commentary on the Song of Songs, Prologus (Rufinus’s Latin). Partial on this page: §§1–10.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Commentary on the Song of Songs, Prologus — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks this commentary; Lawson ACW 26 is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Prologus §§1–10. The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VIII (GCS 33, 1925), Rufinus’s Latin of the Commentary Prologus. Lawson ACW 26 was not used as wording. This page is Prologus §§1–10.
